title: Staff AI Product Designer
description:
About the job

Build the future of payments with AI, Pix & Open Finance

Type: Full-Time

Language: English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Reports to: Head of design

The Company

Nova is building a new generation payment network (i.e. reinventing Visa/Mastercard) using AI on top of Pix and Open Finance.

Its first product is a B2C digital wallet that functions as an infrastructure bridge between traditional credit cards and Pix, allowing consumers to use their existing credit card

limits anywhere, even to pay Pix and Boletos in installments.

The company was founded by an elite team of fintech veterans and has had top-tier venture capital investors (Monashees, Canary, Canaan and Propel) since its inception.

They recently raised a large Series A and are now assembling a small team of exceptional experienced professionals to build, launch and grow its next generation of products.

The Role

We are looking for an exceptional individual to help design, build and scale Nova's next generation of products, working closely with the founders and the greater founding team. We're looking for an outstanding product designer who will:

  • Lead the design of payment experiences for both consumers and merchants, across mobile apps and desktop platforms, from research to polished, shipped product.
  • Help shape Nova's product vision and design direction, influencing decisions beyond your own projects.
  • Raise the design quality bar across the product, mentoring others and improving how the whole team ships UI.
  • Operate as an important IC designer, partnering directly with founders and leaders on product vision
  • Build and evolve design systems ensuring scalable, accessible, and delightful UIs.
  • Prototype and test ideas rapidly, validating hypotheses with real users.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product and engineering to align design decisions with business outcomes.
  • Share work frequently in constructive design critiques and contribute to our design culture of openness and iteration.
  • Occasionally support brand and marketing initiatives (landing pages, campaigns) when your craft can raise the bar.

This is your chance to be a key player at work, working on challenging projects with significant impact, as part of a select team of members at an ambitious and unique new payment network company.

The Qualifications

Required:

  • 7+ years designing digital products with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, including mobile interfaces.
  • Strong visual and interaction design craft with systematic thinking.
  • Daily use of AI in your design workflow (research, synthesis, spec'ing, prototyping).
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments, balancing high quality with speed.
  • Full professional proficiency in English

Preferred:

  • Experience building and shipping production-quality interfaces with AI coding tools (Replit, Cursor, Claude Code, v0, etc.), reducing or removing the need for front-end handoff.
  • Experience in fintech or payments in Brazil.
  • Background in early-stage startups, especially in 0→1 environments.
  • Familiarity with user research, testing, and product analytics tools (Amplitude, Metabase).

The Target Companies

Candidates with at least 2 years of full-time experience in the companies below will be prioritized:

  • Strong Fintechs: Nubank, Revolut, Wise, Mercado Pago, Brex, Itaú, Cora...
  • Strong Local Digital Product Companies: QuintoAndar, iFood, Wildlife, Mercado Livre, Globo...
  • Strong Design Consultancies: Work&Co, Metalab, Huge, R/GA, Accenture Song...
  • Big Tech: Google, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft
  • Other Tech: Notion, Netflix, Uber, Lyft, Airbnb, Spotify, Snap, X (Twitter), Pinterest

The Selection Process

Materials about Nova, including a pitch deck and pitch videos will be made available through the process

Portfolio Review: Async review of your portfolio by the design team to assess craft, depth of thinking, and end-to-end product work. Portfolio is required.

Screening Call: 15 min call with HR for alignment on requirements and qualifications.

Deep Dive Interview: 60 min call with Hiring Manager to deep dive on past experiences and profile.

Bar Raiser Interview: 45 min call with another leader to validate assessment with a 2nd opinion.

Cultural Fit Interview: 30 min call with CEO to evaluate culture fit and answer questions about Nova.

The Offer Package

  • Model: PJ
  • Compensation: aggressive salary
  • Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants
  • Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and Wellhub

If you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. title: Senior Aeronautical Hydromechanical Systems Designer
description:
Summary Description

We are looking for a Senior Aeronautical Hydromechanical Systems Designer to work on the development, integration, and detailing of hydromechanical systems in civil and military aeronautical programs. The professional will be responsible for technical leading design activities, proposing robust solutions for highly complex systems, and acting as a technical reference for the team, contributing to all phases of the product development cycle, from conception to certification.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop aeronautical hydromechanical installation projects in a 3D CAD environment;
  • Prepare installation layouts, integration drawings, and technical documentation;
  • Develop solutions for the installation of hydraulic, environmental (AMS/ECS), fuel, propulsion, and other embedded mechanical systems;
  • Specify aeronautical components, materials, piping, hoses, connections, and hardware;
  • Prepare bills of materials (BOM) and engineering documentation;
  • Develop integration solutions between hydromechanical systems, structures, electrical systems, and avionics;
  • Perform integration, segregation, and install ability analyses of systems;
  • Conduct technical analyses and support the definition of the physical architecture of hydromechanical systems;
  • Support manufacturing, installation, integration, and troubleshooting activities in the field;
  • Support development, qualification, and certification testing campaigns;
  • Analyze technical requirements and ensure their correct implementation in the project;
  • Act as a technical interface with clients, suppliers, and multidisciplinary teams;
  • Prepare and review technical documentation according to internal processes and certification requirements;
  • Provide technical guidance to junior and senior professionals, disseminating best practices in engineering and design;
  • Contribute to the standardization, continuous improvement, and evolution of engineering processes.

Requirements

Education

• Technical course in Mechanics, Mechatronics, Electromechanics or related areas.

Desirable:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Mechatronics or related areas.

Experience

  • Over 10 years of experience in the design of aeronautical hydromechanical systems.
  • Proven experience in aircraft development, modification or certification programs.

Technical knowledge

Hydromechanical Systems Project

  • Design and detailing of aeronautical hydromechanical installations;
  • Hydraulic Systems;
  • Environmental Systems (AMS/ECS);
  • Fuel Systems;
  • Propulsion Systems;
  • Pneumatic Systems;
  • Installation of engines, APU and their associated systems;
  • Sizing and installation of rigid and flexible piping;
  • Definition of supports, fixings and mechanical interfaces;
  • Specification of aeronautical components, materials, piping, connections and hardware;
  • Preparation of bills of materials (BOM);
  • Reading and interpreting technical drawings and engineering documentation.

Aeronautical Knowledge

  • Aeronautical Product Development Process;
  • Integration and segregation of systems;
  • Aeronautical manufacturing and assembly process;
  • Best practices for installing aeronautical systems;
  • Development, qualification, and certification testing;
  • Application of Service Bulletins and major modifications (STC);
  • Certification process for civil and military aircraft.

Tools

Desirable experience with tools such as:

  • CATIA V5 / 3DEXPERIENCE;
  • Microsoft Office.

Desired skills

  • Analytical thinking and ability to solve complex problems;
  • Organization and planning;
  • Clear and objective technical communication;
  • Ability to act as a technical reference in multidisciplinary teams;
  • Ease of interpersonal relationships;
  • Collaborative and results-oriented profile;
  • Proactivity and sense of responsibility;
  • Autonomy in technical decision-making;
  • Commitment to quality, safety, and deadlines;
  • Ability to guide and develop less experienced professionals.

Differentials

Experience in the following will be considered a plus:

  • Large-scale aeronautical modification projects (STC);
  • Civil or military certification programs;
  • Hydraulic flight control systems;
  • Fuel systems;
  • Environmental systems (ECS/AMS);
  • Pneumatic systems;
  • Installation of engines, APUs, and nacelles;
  • Integration of special and mission systems;
  • DOORS, Polarion, or requirements management tools;
  • FAR/CS 23 or 25 standards;
  • ARP4754A, ARP4761, and DO-160;
  • ANAC, FAA, or EASA certification processes;
  • Installability, maintainability, functional safety, and multidisciplinary interface analyses.

Languages

  • Advanced English for reading, interpreting, and preparing technical documentation.
  • Fluent English will be considered a plus.

Availability

  • National and international travel, when necessary.
  • Ability to work different shifts as needed by projects.

What do we expect

We are looking for professionals passionate about aeronautical engineering, with solid technical experience and the ability to lead highly complex solutions. We expect individuals committed to excellence in engineering, who work collaboratively, positively influence team development, and contribute to the delivery of safe, innovative, and certifiable projects, strengthening the technical capacity and competitiveness of Systems Engineering.

title: Formação de Assessores de Investimento

title: Analista de logística
description:
Faça parte de uma empresa líder em bens de consumo, reconhecida por suas marcas presentes na rotina de milhões de consumidores.

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar na liderança das operações logísticas de um centro de distribuição, garantindo a excelência operacional, a segurança das pessoas e a eficiência dos processos.   • Atuar em parceria com áreas como Transportes, Vendas, Segurança, Qualidade e demais áreas de suporte, assegurando alinhamento e eficiência dos processos.

Requisitos

Diferenciais

O que buscamos

Procuramos um(a) profissional com perfil de liderança, senso de dono, capacidade de tomada de decisão e foco em resultados. Alguém que goste de desenvolver pessoas, construir relacionamentos entre áreas e contribuir para a evolução contínua da operação.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos que equipes diversas geram melhores resultados. Todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas para a oportunidade, independentemente de gênero, raça, etnia, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

title: Latin America Business Development and Sales Manager
description:
Position Summary:

The Latin America Business Development and Sales Manager will develop the sales of the company's products and services. This person will drive profitable growth in sales revenues through proactive deployment of innovative sales techniques, identifying clear objectives, impactful sales calls, and executing action plans. Initially, this is an individual performing position, direct contact, hands-on role with subordinates to be added as business growth dictates. There are near-term potential advancement opportunities that may include the management of a small team focused on sales and technical support. This team member will work very closely with the entire PBE Group Global Sales Team, engineering, and operations to drive positive changes.

Responsibilities

  • Directly drive sales and services efforts by engaging current customers and heavily pursuing new business developing new end markets
  • Develop, recommend, and implement sales and marketing tactics to include distributor training, trade shows, and other customer communications that will drive revenue growth.
  • Build, develop, and maintain strategic relationships to cultivate prosperous new partnerships across diverse industries
  • Develop strategic sales plans/projections based on strategic plans, establish operations sales targets linked to plan, and monitor/report performance
  • Establish new markets, increase customer base, and expand overall sales presence by identifying new opportunities and new technologies to add to the PBE portfolio
  • Accurately forecasts annual, quarterly, and monthly revenue
  • Collaborate with PBE Group Global Sales team members to develop sales strategies to improve market share in all product lines and exploit global, strategic accounts
  • Partner with PBE purchasing, quoting, and production staff to ensure the delivery of a quality product, fit-for-purpose, on-time and on budget
  • Establish a budget and work within the constraints to maximize customer interaction and support
  • Properly maintain records in the CRM system

Education/Work Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing or related field. Masters degree or MBA is a plus.
  • Five (5) years sales and/or sales management experience
  • Familiarity with developing distribution channels and successful sales plans
  • Background in sales and business development with an engineering, electrical, or systems focus
  • Experience with communications networks and safety/productivity systems in the mining industry

Physical Demands:

While performing duties, the employee may be required sit for periods of time while working or while traveling, walk, stand, occasionally lift, pull, push up to 30 pounds, or occasionally kneel, stoop, bend as determined necessary.

Capabilities/Skills:

  • Self-motivated, dedicated individual with outstanding intrapersonal skills
  • Must have more than five (5+) years success in establishing B2B tangible product sales
  • Solid presentation skills for both on-site and boardroom settings
  • Must be familiar with the Leaky Feeder and collision avoidance market
  • Must have a proven track record of customer development, retention, goal attainment, and achieving or exceeding sales goals or targets
  • Must have the ability to travel via ground or air transportation up to 50% of the time
  • Must have easy access to airports for travel with limited commute time
  • Must have appropriate Visas, or be able to obtain appropriate Visas as necessary for travel
  • Able to communicate effectively through written and verbal methods
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to lead technical discussions
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) in both verbal and written communication skills
  • Fluent with Microsoft Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel, Teams, etc.) and ability to be trained in other software platforms as deemed appropriate
  • Able to adapt to a fast-paced environment
  • Attention to detail and ability to correct as needed
  • Ability to analyze information in a real time environment while seeking resolution, solving problems, and proactively assessing work patterns for a more efficient outcome
  • Ability to learn product line

Preferred Skills:

  • Extensive and established network of distributors, potential partners, and industry contacts in the mining and construction industries
  • Experience with confined space or underground communications in the mining or tunnel industries
  • General understanding of DAS, LTE, and Leaky Feeder communication systems
  • Experience with communication network and safety/productivity systems in the mining, construction, or various other applicable industries

Depending on region and customer needs, this candidate may be required to pass background checks and drug screenings as a condition of employment.

title: Coordenadora da qualidade - segmento de serviços de alimentação
description:
Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Segurança dos Alimentos (Food Safety):
  • Assegurar o cumprimento rigoroso da legislação sanitária vigente (RDC 216/04 da ANVISA, portarias estaduais/municipais e legislações específicas para o setor).
  • Elaborar, atualizar e supervisionar a implantação do Manual de Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF), Procedimentos Operacionais Padronizados (POPs) e Planos APPCC (Análise de Perigos e Pontos Críticos de Controle).

  • Auditorias, Inspeções e Controle de Pragas:
  • Realizar auditorias internas periódicas em todas as unidades de alimentação e refeitórios operados, emitindo relatórios de não conformidade e planos de ação corretiva/preventiva.

  • Gerenciar o contrato e a eficácia do serviço terceirizado de controle de pragas e vetores nas unidades.
  • Gestão de Indicadores e Qualidade Assegurada:
  • Controlar e analisar indicadores de qualidade (ex: índice de rejeição de matérias-primas, resultados de análises microbiológicas de água e alimentos, reclamações de clientes, desvios de temperatura).
  • Realizar auditorias de fornecedores e homologação de matérias-primas em conjunto com o setor de Compras.
  • Gerenciar o programa de controle de qualidade de amostras de alimentos (counter samples).
  • Treinamento e Desenvolvimento de Equipes:
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos obrigatórios e reciclagens em Boas Práticas, higiene pessoal, manipulação higiênica e prevenção de contaminação cruzada para cozinheiros, copeiros, nutricionistas e auxiliares.
  • Disseminar a cultura de qualidade e segurança de alimentos na operação ("zero tolerância" para falhas de higiene).

title: ANALISTA DE PRODUTOS PL (PDV)
description:

ANALISTA DE PRODUTOS PL (ARQUITETURA/PDV/IMAGENS)

Formação Superior Concluída em Arquitetura e Urbanismo;

Desejável Pós-Graduação em áreas correlatas.

O Grupo Patrimar consolidou seu compromisso com a diversidade, inclusão e equidade através de um manifesto oficial e do Programa Gente, uma iniciativa estratégica voltada para a criação de um ambiente de trabalho justo, plural e produtivo. title: Estagiário(a) em Marketing | Social Media e Criação
description:
O desafio que te espera

Você é uma pessoa criativa, que os outros costumam dizer que é "cronicamente online" e gosta de transformar ideias em conteúdos que chamam atenção?

Tem iniciativa para colocar a mão na massa, testar formatos diferentes e buscar referências sem precisar esperar alguém dizer exatamente o que fazer?

É ligada nas redes sociais, gosta de gravar vídeos, e quando chegam com uma novidade/notícia, você já estava sabendo dela muito antes de todo mundo?

Se você respondeu sim, essa vaga pode ser para você.

A BestContent é uma startup em crescimento acelerado, e buscamos alguém que queira aprender, evoluir e crescer junto com a empresa.

Aqui, você não vai entrar apenas para executar uma lista de posts. Queremos alguém que participe das ideias, ajude a construir a presença da marca e tenha espaço para testar novos formatos, acompanhar resultados e desenvolver suas habilidades na prática.

Você terá contato próximo com os times de Social Media, Design, Growth e Produto, participando de discussões sobre campanhas, lançamentos, funcionalidades e novas formas de comunicar a BestContent.

Sobre a BestContent AI

Toda empresa sabe que precisa produzir conteúdo com frequência — mas poucas conseguem manter uma presença constante, relevante e alinhada à própria marca. Produzir dá trabalho: exige tempo, repertório, organização e um monte de ferramenta diferente. Pra pequenos negócios, manter esse ritmo é caro, lento e difícil de escalar.

É esse problema que a gente resolve! A BestContent é uma plataforma de inteligência artificial que cria, planeja e distribui conteúdos para redes sociais, adaptados à identidade visual e ao tom de voz de cada negócio.

Na prática, ajudamos empresas a transformarem suas ideias em conteúdos, carrosséis, stories, vídeos, criativos e campanhas de forma muito mais rápida, organizada e escalável. Ajudamos empresas de todos os portes desde o planejamento até o acompanhamento dos resultados gerados.

Nosso objetivo é claro: nos tornar a IA de marketing e criação de conteúdo mais usada do Brasil.

O que você vai fazer

Seu papel será ajudar a fortalecer a presença digital da BestContent, transformando ideias, novidades, estratégias e funcionalidades da empresa em conteúdos relevantes para as nossas redes sociais.

No dia a dia, você vai:

  • Apoiar a criação e a produção de conteúdos para Instagram, TikTok, Reels, LinkedIn e outros canais - Participando da criação e às vezes aparecendo no conteúdo;
  • Pesquisar tendências, referências, creators e formatos relevantes pro nosso público — e adaptá-los ao contexto da marca;
  • Organizar o calendário editorial e apoiar o planejamento das publicações;
  • Sugerir novas ideias, campanhas, quadros e formatos para as redes sociais da marca;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial para pesquisar, organizar informações, desenvolver ideias, criar roteiros e otimizar a produção de conteúdo;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de Design, Growth, Produto e com as lideranças da empresa;
  • Apoiar o contato com creators e parceiros, ajudando na pesquisa de perfis e em ações de conteúdo em conjunto.
  • Ajudar a organizar referências, aprendizados e boas práticas para tornar nosso processo de criação cada vez mais eficiente.

O que buscamos

Não esperamos que você já saiba tudo. Essa é uma vaga de estágio, e buscamos alguém com vontade real de aprender, experimentar e evoluir.

Buscamos uma pessoa com:

  • Boa comunicação e escrita;
  • Criatividade e repertório de redes sociais;
  • Interesse por marketing, conteúdo, tecnologia e inteligência artificial;
  • Facilidade para identificar tendências e altamente conectado;
  • Um perfil analítico, que não apenas executa as demandas mas também busca entender padrões no que se gerou de resultado;
  • Organização para acompanhar demandas, conteúdos e prazos;
  • Proatividade para pesquisar, sugerir ideias e colocar projetos em prática;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe, ouvir diferentes pontos de vista e receber feedbacks;
  • Curiosidade para aprender sobre produto, comportamento do público e estratégias de comunicação;
  • Responsabilidade e autonomia para conduzir suas próprias demandas com acompanhamento do time;
  • Disponibilidade para um encontro presencial semanal no Ninna Hub, em Fortaleza.

O que seria um UAU

Não é obrigatório, mas conta pontos:

  • Já ter criado conteúdo pra redes, mesmo em projeto pessoal (portfólio, perfil, canal, collab);
  • Experiência com TikTok, Reels ou vídeos curtos, e facilidade diante da câmera;
  • Familiaridade com CapCut, Canva, Premiere ou ferramentas similares;
  • Experiência com planejamento e calendário editorial;
  • Noção de métricas de Instagram e TikTok;
  • Já ter usado ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação de conteúdo;
  • Interesse pelo universo de startups, tecnologia e produtos digitais;
  • Participação em Empresa Júnior, projetos de extensão, PET, CEMP ou iniciativas estudantis;

Como a gente trabalha

Trabalho remoto, com um encontro presencial por semana no Ninna Hub, em Fortaleza;

Ambiente de startup em crescimento acelerado, no qual novas ideias podem ser testadas rapidamente;

Contato direto com as pessoas que tomam as decisões — aqui você aprende rápido e acompanha a estratégia por dentro;

Espaço para aprender, experimentar formatos, sugerir ideias e participar das decisões de conteúdo;

Acesso às principais ferramentas de inteligência artificial do mercado para utilizar no seu dia a dia;

Trabalho próximo aos times de Social Media, Design, Growth e Produto;

Possibilidade real de desenvolvimento e crescimento dentro da empresa;

Construção de PDIs semestrais, com objetivos claros e acompanhamento da sua evolução profissional;

Possibilidade de receber vesting — participação na empresa — mediante performance, evolução e entregas;

Ambiente com espaço para assumir novas responsabilidades conforme seu desenvolvimento;

Um time aberto a novas ideias, referências e formas diferentes de fazer as coisas.

Sobre a candidatura

Para se candidatar, envie seu currículo e alguma amostra do seu trabalho (caso tenha).

Pode ser um portfólio, perfil de rede social, vídeo, roteiro, publicação, projeto acadêmico ou qualquer outro material que mostre um pouco da sua criatividade e da sua capacidade de comunicação.

Não precisa ser algo profissional. Queremos conhecer como você pensa, pesquisa, cria e transforma ideias em conteúdo.

title: Especialista em Negócios | Atendimento - Fundos de Investimento
description:

title: R&D Manager

title: Aeronautical Electrical Systems Designer - Senior
description:
Summary Description

We are looking for a Senior Aeronautical Electrical Systems Designer to work on the development, integration, and detailing of electrical systems in civil and military aeronautical programs. The professional will be responsible for technical leading design activities, proposing robust solutions for highly complex systems, and acting as a technical reference for the team, contributing to all phases of the product development cycle, from conception to certification.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop aeronautical hydromechanical installation projects in a 3D CAD environment;
  • Prepare installation layouts, integration drawings, and technical documentation;
  • Develop solutions for the installation of hydraulic, environmental (AMS/ECS), fuel, propulsion, and other embedded mechanical systems;
  • Specify aeronautical components, materials, piping, hoses, connections, and hardware;
  • Prepare bills of materials (BOM) and engineering documentation;
  • Develop integration solutions between hydromechanical systems, structures, electrical systems, and avionics;
  • Perform system integration and segregation analyses;
  • Support the manufacturing, installation, and integration of systems;
  • Support development testing, qualification, and certification activities;
  • Participate in the analysis of technical requirements and their implementation in the project;
  • Interact with clients, suppliers, and multidisciplinary teams in defining technical solutions;
  • Prepare engineering documentation according to internal processes and certification requirements;
  • Provide technical support to junior professionals and contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes.

Requirements

Education

• Technical course in Electrical, Electronics, Electrotechnics, Mechatronics or related areas.

Desirable:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronic, Mechatronics, Aeronautical Engineering or related area

Experience

  • Over 10 years of experience in the design of aeronautical electrical systems.
  • Proven experience in aircraft development, modification or certification programs.

Technical knowledge

Electrical Systems Design Project

  • Design and detailing of aeronautical electrical installations;
  • Preparation and interpretation of electrical diagrams;
  • Development of wiring diagrams;
  • Preparation of wire lists and bills of materials (BOM);
  • Design of wiring routing (EWIS);
  • Installation of onboard electrical and electronic equipment;
  • Definition of supports, fixings, and mechanical interfaces;
  • Specification of hardware, materials, connectors, and aeronautical components;
  • Reading and interpretation of technical drawings and engineering documentation.

Aeronautical Knowledge

  • Aeronautical Product Development Process;
  • EWIS (Electrical Wiring Interconnection System);
  • Integration and segregation of systems;
  • Aeronautical manufacturing and assembly process;
  • Best practices for the installation of aeronautical systems;
  • Development, qualification, and certification testing;
  • Application of Service Bulletins and major modifications (STC);
  • Certification process for civil and military aircraft.

Tools

Desirable experience with tools such as:

  • CATIA V5 / 3DEXPERIENCE;
  • E3.series (Zuken) or IGE+XAO;
  • Microsoft Office.

Desired skills

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills;
  • Organization and planning skills;
  • Good verbal and written communication skills;
  • Multidisciplinary teamwork skills;
  • Strong interpersonal skills;
  • Collaborative and results-oriented profile;
  • Proactive and responsible;
  • Ability to work in a dynamic environment;
  • Flexibility to handle changing priorities;
  • Commitment to quality, safety, and deadlines.

Desirable Skills

Experience in the following areas will be considered a plus:

  • Large-scale aeronautical modification projects (STC);
  • Civil or military certification programs;
  • Hydraulic flight control systems;
  • Fuel systems;
  • Environmental systems (ECS/AMS);
  • Pneumatic systems;
  • Engine and APU installation;
  • Integration of special and mission systems;
  • DOORS, Polarion, or requirements management tools;
  • FAR/CS 23 or 25 standards;
  • ARP4754A, ARP4761 and DO-160;
  • ANAC, FAA or EASA certification processes.

Languages

  • Intermediate English (reading and interpreting technical documentation).
  • Advanced English will be considered a plus.

Availability

  • National and international travel, when necessary.
  • Willingness to work different shifts as needed by projects.

What do we expect

We are looking for professionals passionate about aeronautical engineering, with solid technical experience and the ability to lead highly complex solutions. We expect individuals committed to excellence in engineering, who work collaboratively, positively influence team development, and contribute to the delivery of safe, innovative, and certifiable projects, strengthening the technical capacity and competitiveness of Systems Engineering.

title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager
description:
This role has overall responsibility for business forecasts and evaluation of current & future business activities/opportunities.

The Financial Planning and Reporting Manager works closely with:

  • With territory marketing, production, research and ad sales teams as the point of contact for business forecasting, channel and product financial performance analysis, commercial profit reporting;
  • Financial Controllers as an interface between the actual and forecast results as well as support with monthly close/reporting activity;

Management Reporting

  • Co-ordinates and manages in-territory annual and monthly management review process vs budget & forecast for P & L and balance-sheet items.
  • Assess the organizational performance against budget and strategy and provide challenge and insight into financial performance to enable appropriate decisions to be made on future performance and growth
  • Provides commentaries, analysis and insight on key trends , initiatives and risks and opportunities at Territory level for input to the Management pack.
  • Provides title P&L analysis and participants reporting

Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting

  • Manage the forecast and plan review and approval process with hub and corporate
  • Coordinate and prepare the draft annual budget (revenue, cost and overhead), and additionally for the quarterly forecast
  • Co-ordinate timely input of financial and business drivers into the global 3 year plan
  • Identify and agree KPIs which track performance against Business Plans.
  • Translates market conditions into the financial forecast
  • Tests alternative high level business scenarios and run sensitivity analysis and assess risks and opportunities with the territories and hub management team
  • Partner with the Sales/Mktg/Operations teams to provide financial insight
  • Prepare and review the cash forecast
  • Prepare the supporting analysis of the flash reporting and monthly forecasts
  • Liaise with Sales to develop customer level budgets and forecasts
  • Support managers to develop tactical, operational and capital plans and initiatives to deliver targets

Projects, Analysis and Continuous Improvement

  • Optimize tools and systems to provide critical financial and operational information and make actionable recommendations on strategy and operations
  • Identify and ensure implementation of process improvements to continually improve performance
  • Analyses commercial proposals to support decision-making, including discount structures, promotions analysis, customer profitability analysis
  • Actively participate as part of ad-hoc global teams to develop enhanced tools & processes followed by tactical implementation locally

Global Finance team

  • Works with, supports, and is supported by FP&A Managers, Financial Controllers, Business Analysts, Finance Directors and Home Office members of the global team
  • Builds an environment based on trust, respect, teamwork, initiative and innovation

Strong knowledge of:

  • US GAAP,and how to apply it, and when applicable to business results and forecasts.
  • Tools, approaches, roles, techniques, processes and/or procedures needed to:
  • Establish and monitor budgets.
  • Explore and evaluate alternative financial scenarios and results.
  • Analyze a product, customer, process, or project in terms of cost and benefits.
  • Create and maintain accurate and thorough financial reports.
  • Recognize, anticipate, and resolve organization, operations or process problems.

Strong ability to:

  • Effectively communicate across the Business and Finance organization with strong English oral and written skills
  • Co-ordinate and own a complex process through clear communication and organization of disparate participants to deliver a timely and effective output
  • Analysis of underlying financial and non financial data to provide an insight into the performance to enable the appropriate decisions to be made
  • Provide clear, understandable and meaningful insights in to the business to support the management to making informed business decisions
  • Work in a fast moving and changing environment, and manage multiple priorities.
  • Establish collaborative and productive relationships with clients, vendors and peers to facilitate excellent business support.
  • Read, interpret and draw accurate conclusions from financial and numerical material.
  • Work with and manipulate multiple data sources to generate useful and insightful data.
  • Create, implement, evaluate and enhance internal control processes.

Other:

  • Experience of working in an international organization and in the entertainment sector
  • Continually seeks to exceed expectations through self and team development.
  • Ability to forge strong, international relationships with diverse teams.
  • Be comfortable with ambiguity in a dynamic, changing, commercial environment
  • Demonstrate true learning agility
  • Build effective teams, understanding the importance of team culture & values.
  • Act collaboratively at all times, and build successful partner relationships.

description:

Você será peça-chave para garantir a confiabilidade dos dados, auxiliando na estruturação de visões gerenciais que suportem a tomada de decisão e garantam a visibilidade do desempenho financeiro para as áreas de negócio atendidas.

  • Orçamento e Projeções: Contribuir com a construção do orçamento anual e revisões trimestrais (forecast), auxiliando no levantamento de premissas, coleta de dados de receitas, custos e despesas junto à operação.
  • Rotina Contábil e Alocações: Garantir as corretas alocações de receitas, custos e despesas conforme os centros de custo da estrutura de Sustentação, atuando em interface com a Contabilidade para justificar lançamentos e respeitar as regras da companhia.

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Ensino Superior completo (ou cursando) em Administração de Empresas, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Específicos:

Não exigimos conhecimentos avançados como macros/VBA, mas muita vontade de aprender!

title: Collections Analyst
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the Job

We're building Brazil's largest B2B credit infrastructure, and we're looking for a Collections Analyst who is a true negotiation master to play a key role in that journey. You'll be on the front line of debt recovery, negotiating directly — and skillfully — with a wide range of profiles, from small business owners to C-Level executives at global companies, always finding the angle that gets deals done while building the kind of trust that strengthens Credix's relationships with its clients. But this role goes beyond collecting: you'll think strategically, analyzing delinquency data, surfacing actionable insights, and helping shape the future of our automation-first collections model. If you're a natural dealmaker, a decisive owner, a clear communicator, and thrive in a dynamic credit landscape, this is the role for you.

Qualifications

  • 1–2 year of experience in collections, accounts receivable, customer service, call centers, or operational roles.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers, monitoring payments and driving collection negotiations with the skill of a true dealmaker — efficient, respectful, and always finding a path to resolution.
  • Monitor and control accounts receivable, ensuring financial records are accurate, organized, and up to date.
  • Use Excel and SQL to analyze data, track key performance indicators, and manage the collections portfolio. Support the automation of operational processes using Python (preferred) to improve efficiency and streamline workflows.
  • Investigate and resolve payment discrepancies, providing timely and effective solutions.
  • Prioritize competing demands and manage multiple tasks while maintaining a high level of organization and attention to detail.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure an excellent customer experience and drive operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned client wallet, negotiating like a true master dealmaker over phone and messaging and recovering outstanding debts across varied customer profiles — from small business owners to C-Level executives at global companies.
  • Take ownership of decisions and proactively align with cross-functional teams to solve collection challenges.
  • Prepare daily and weekly reports on recovery rates, DPD trends, and case resolutions.
  • Analyze delinquency data to generate actionable insights that improve collection strategies.
  • Automate repetitive tasks and use tools like Python and SQL to build scripts that improve process efficiency.
  • Identify inefficiencies and implement automated workflows to streamline collections processes.
  • Conduct quality audits of external collection agencies, providing feedback to improve recovery rates.
  • Track performance against KPIs, including recoveries per OKR/Collections Policy and percentage of automated workflows implemented.

What We Offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our São Paulo office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, learn, and grow together.

In addition, we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation, where curiosity is encouraged.
  • Competitive salary package.
  • Equity stock options plan.
  • Paid holidays.
  • Clear growth opportunities within collections and operations.
  • Team off-sites focused on collaboration, fun, and shared experiences.

title: Técnico de enfermagem
description:
descrição da empresa Contour Clinique é uma clínica voltada ao cuidado integral da saúde com foco em qualidade de atendimento e bem-estar de pacientes. A equipe é multidisciplinar e atua com protocolos atualizados que priorizam segurança conforto e resultado clínico. O ambiente de trabalho valoriza colaboração desenvolvimento contínuo e relacionamento respeitoso entre profissionais e pacientes. Quem integra a clínica encontra oportunidade de crescimento técnico e participação ativa na construção de processos de excelência em saúde.

descrição do cargo o cargo de técnico de enfermagem na Contour Clinique envolve atendimento direto a pacientes em ambiente clínico em São Paulo SP Jardins. no dia a dia a pessoa profissional realiza procedimentos de enfermagem orientação aos pacientes controle de sinais vitais administração de medicamentos conforme prescrição acompanhamento de evolução clínica e registro em prontuário. também apoia a equipe médica e de enfermagem na organização da rotina na preparação de materiais e na manutenção das condições de higiene e segurança. este é um cargo de tempo integral com atuação presencial.

qualificações

  • formação completa como técnico de enfermagem com registro ativo no conselho regional de enfermagem e desejável certificação complementar em assistência direta a pacientes.
  • experiência em cuidados diretos a pacientes com domínio de técnicas de enfermagem controle de sinais vitais e apoio a procedimentos médicos.
  • conhecimento básico em princípios de enfermagem e medicina aplicados ao ambiente clínico incluindo noções de farmacologia administração de medicamentos e biossegurança.
  • habilidade para comunicação clara e acolhedora trabalho em equipe organização de rotina e atenção a detalhes garantindo segurança e conforto de pacientes.
  • diferenciais incluem experiência prévia em clínicas ou hospitais cursos de atualização em boas práticas de enfermagem e disponibilidade para aprender protocolos específicos da Contour Clinique.

Requisitos:

  • Curso Técnico de Enfermagem completo.
  • COREN ativo e regular.
  • Experiência prévia em clínica estética, centro cirúrgico, pós-operatório ou procedimentos corporais.
  • Conhecimento no manuseio, preparo e acompanhamento de equipamentos utilizados em tecnologias corporais.
  • Experiência com protocolos de biossegurança, assepsia, organização de sala e controle de materiais.
  • Experiência no acompanhamento de cirurgias e procedimentos médicos será um diferencial.
  • Boa comunicação, postura profissional, responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.

Conhecimentos desejáveis em tecnologias corporais:

  • Preparo e organização de equipamentos corporais antes dos atendimentos.
  • Noções de parâmetros, ponteiras, higienização e conservação dos aparelhos.
  • Acompanhamento de procedimentos corporais conforme protocolo da clínica.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias como radiofrequência, ultrassom, endermoterapia, criolipólise, corrente, drenagem assistida, aparelhos para gordura localizada, flacidez, celulite e pós-operatório.
  • Capacidade de identificar desconfortos, intercorrências ou reações do paciente durante o procedimento e comunicar imediatamente a equipe responsável.

Atividades da função:

  • Preparar o paciente para procedimentos estéticos, corporais e cirúrgicos.
  • Auxiliar a equipe médica e de enfermagem no pré, intra e pós-procedimento.
  • Acompanhar cirurgias e procedimentos realizados na clínica.
  • Organizar sala, materiais, equipamentos e prontuários antes e após os atendimentos.
  • Realizar cuidados de enfermagem conforme prescrição, protocolo interno e supervisão do enfermeiro responsável.
  • Auxiliar em curativos, assepsia, paramentação, controle de materiais e biossegurança.
  • Preparar, higienizar e conferir equipamentos utilizados em tecnologias corporais.
  • Acompanhar pacientes durante o uso dos equipamentos, observando conforto, segurança e possíveis intercorrências.
  • Registrar informações em prontuário/anotação de enfermagem.
  • Orientar o paciente conforme as condutas definidas pela equipe responsável.
  • Manter a organização, limpeza técnica e fluxo adequado dos ambientes de atendimento.

Perfil desejado:

  • Buscamos profissional responsável, proativo(a), cuidadoso(a), com boa postura, discrição, atenção ao paciente e interesse em atuar na área estética/cirúrgica. É importante ter segurança no ambiente clínico, saber seguir protocolos e trabalhar com excelência no atendimento.

title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator who will be responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of all broadcast and content initiatives within Free Fire Esports. This role combines production, storytelling, and digital strategy expertise to deliver world-class esports broadcasts and high-impact content that enhance the fan experience. The Broadcast & Content Specialist/Coordinator acts as a bridge between internal teams, external vendors, influencers, and regional stakeholders to ensure creative alignment, operational excellence, and consistent brand storytelling across all tournaments and platforms.

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the full broadcast and content pipeline for Free Fire Esports — from pre-production planning to live execution and post-event content delivery.
  • Manage relationships with broadcast vendors, studios, and creative agencies, ensuring adherence to Garena's quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Supervise on-site production during tournaments, overseeing show flow, run-down execution, and coordination between technical, talent, and content teams.
  • Drive the creative direction of tournament broadcasts, including narrative development, talent integration, segment design, and audience interaction.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing and Social Media teams to align content distribution plans, ensuring maximum reach and engagement across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development of post-production deliverables (recaps, highlights, interviews, documentaries, etc.), ensuring consistency in tone, pacing, and storytelling.
  • Analyze viewership and engagement data to inform future broadcast and content strategies, identifying performance trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Support marketing teams with guidelines and toolkits to ensure global consistency of broadcast quality and messaging.
  • Manage the internal review process for scripts, visual assets, and show rundowns, ensuring narrative cohesion and compliance with brand standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging broadcast technologies, formats, and fan engagement tools to continuously evolve Free Fire Esports' viewing experience.

Main job requirements:

  • Education: Completed higher education. Desirable in Communication, Broadcasting, Media Production, or related fields.
  • Experience: 6+ years in esports broadcast production, live event coordination, or content operations.
  • Proven track record leading complex, large-scale broadcast projects with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Strong understanding of esports ecosystems, gaming audiences, and live content dynamics.
  • Experience managing creative and technical production teams (e.g., camera crew, stage talent, editors, motion designers).
  • Solid analytical skills and ability to translate viewership metrics into actionable insights.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful execution of esports or entertainment broadcasts and digital content initiatives.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.
  • Preferred: Previous experience with international esports tournaments or live entertainment events. Familiarity with OBS, vMix, or other live production software, and knowledge of streaming infrastructure. Comfortable working under high-pressure live event conditions

title: Arquiteto de Soluções Sênior | Cloud & Microserviços (Híbrido)
description:
Ola!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios. Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:

O seu papel no time:

  • Compreender requisitos de negócio, técnicos e não funcionais, traduzindo-os em arquiteturas escaláveis, resilientes e seguras, com forte utilização de Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes/AKS, containers, microserviços, APIs e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;
  • Realizar assessments de aplicações e arquiteturas existentes, elaborando desenhos As-Is e To-Be e apoiando estratégias de modernização, migração e evolução tecnológica;
  • Conduzir discussões e workshops técnicos com equipes de desenvolvimento, DevOps, infraestrutura, redes, segurança, integração, fornecedores e demais stakeholders;
  • Identificar riscos, dependências e impactos arquiteturais durante a definição e evolução das soluções;
  • Definir e revisar padrões para microserviços, APIs, comunicação síncrona e assíncrona, mensageria, segurança, observabilidade, resiliência, escalabilidade e integração entre aplicações;
  • Orientar tecnicamente as equipes responsáveis pela implementação, revisando desenhos e soluções e garantindo aderência aos padrões arquiteturais;
  • Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para decisões e problemas técnicos de maior complexidade;

O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Experiência com arquitetura de microserviços e aplicações distribuídas;
  • Conhecimento avançado em APIs REST, OpenAPI e Azure API Management (APIM) / API Gateway;
  • Experiência com Azure Service Bus, mensageria, filas, tópicos e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;
  • Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura como Backend for Frontend (BFF) e comunicação síncrona e assíncrona;
  • Conhecimento em segurança de APIs e aplicações distribuídas, incluindo OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, CORS, TLS/mTLS;
  • Experiência com Azure Entra ID e Azure Key Vault;
  • Conhecimento em Azure Monitor e Application Insights e conceitos de observabilidade, incluindo logs, métricas e tracing;
  • Conhecimento em autoscaling, resiliência e alta disponibilidade;
  • Domínio de conceitos como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Timeout e Idempotência;
  • Conhecimento em Cloud Networking, incluindo VNet, Subnet, DNS, Firewall, Load Balancing, Ingress/Egress, Private Endpoint e Peering;
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em conectividade entre ambientes cloud e on-premises;
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e conceitos de DevSecOps;
  • Conhecimento arquitetural de Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) ou Huawei Cloud;
  • Vivência em ambientes híbridos e multicloud;
  • Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC);
  • Conhecimento em Kafka e OpenTelemetry;
  • Experiência com Terraform;
  • Conhecimento em Azure DevOps e/ou GitHub Actions;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks e metodologias de arquitetura como TOGAF e ArchiMate;
  • Experiência em modernização de aplicações legadas.

O que esperamos de você – Soft Skills:

title: Supervisor Comercial de Campo
description:

Agora, a MAG está iniciando uma nova unidade de negócio, o MAG | +Cuidado - uma solução de acesso à saúde e proteção em momentos críticos para brasileiros sem plano de saúde, elevando o padrão de valor entregue ao cliente e superando o modelo tradicional de "cartões de benefícios" em qualidade, governança e experiência.

Este novo negócio será iniciado em uma cidade estratégica (Sorocaba,SP), com um time de vendas PaP e um Supervisor dedicado. A operação nasce com visão de longo prazo e potencial de escala nacional. À medida que o modelo amadurecer, os Supervisores que liderarem a execução e entregarem resultado consistente se tornam referências naturais para assumir a expansão para novas cidades e futuras regionais, com crescimento e reconhecimento diretamente ligados à performance.

Quais serão seus desafios

  • Montar, desenvolver e manter equipes de vendas externas de alta performance, garantindo reposições rápidas e continuidade dos resultados;
  • Treinar e acompanhar vendedores em campo, assegurando a padronização da abordagem comercial e do discurso de vendas;
  • Conduzir a gestão diária do time, promovendo engajamento, desenvolvimento e acompanhamento contínuo de performance;
  • Realizar rituais de gestão, reuniões de alinhamento e acompanhamentos individuais (1:1), reconhecendo resultados e direcionando melhorias;
  • Monitorar indicadores de produtividade e conversão, identificando oportunidades e propondo ações corretivas de forma ágil;
  • Acompanhar a execução das atividades comerciais, incluindo abordagens, geração de leads, follow-ups e fechamento de vendas;
  • Elaborar relatórios periódicos com análises de resultados, perfil de clientes, oportunidades de melhoria e planos de ação;
  • Mapear oportunidades de geração de negócios na região de atuação, ampliando canais e estratégias de prospecção;
  • Desenvolver e fortalecer parcerias locais com empresas, associações, comércios, instituições religiosas, educacionais e comunitárias;
  • Identificar e engajar influenciadores e lideranças locais que contribuam para ampliar a visibilidade da marca e gerar novas oportunidades comerciais;
  • Planejar e executar ações de ativação comercial, eventos, stands e campanhas locais, acompanhando resultados e retorno sobre investimento.

.

O que esperamos de você?

  • Ensino Técnico completo ou Ensino Superior cursando ou completo;

  • Perfil proativo, resiliente e com forte capacidade de mobilização e engajamento de equipes;
  • Experiência com ações de ativação local, prospecção em campo e desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas;
  • Boa comunicação, influência e habilidade para representar a empresa em eventos, negociações e relacionamentos institucionais;

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Rede própria de vendedores com potencial para rápida mobilização e formação de equipe;

title: Finance Lead
description:
Job Responsibilities

  • Take charge of full-cycle financial management of Focus Media Brazil subsidiary. Establish localized financial systems, processes and accounting standards from scratch to ensure full compliance with local regulations and international financial requirements.
  • Manage relationships with local tax, audit and regulatory authorities, and oversee tax declaration and compliance affairs. Build up financial risk early-warning and control mechanisms to mitigate cross-border fiscal risks and ensure compliant operations.
  • Partner closely with local business operations, providing professional financial support for investment, financing, cost control and tax planning. Optimize budget and capital allocation to improve operational efficiency and support business target achievement.
  • Prepare regular financial analysis reports for local senior management and group headquarters, providing data-driven insights for strategic decisions. Complete group consolidated reporting and ensure consistent financial data and information synchronization with headquarters.

  • Demonstrate a strong sense of responsibility and excellent pressure resistance. Able to adapt to a fast-paced and multi-tasking working environment.

title: Especialista de Prevenção de Perdas (E-commerce)
description:
Buscamos um(a) Especialista de Prevenção de Perdas para atuar nas operações de e-commerce do Grupo, nos galpões responsáveis pelo processamento e distribuição de pedidos.

Essa pessoa será responsável por atuar de forma preventiva e investigativa na identificação de perdas, roubos, extravios, avarias e desvios de mercadorias, acompanhando toda a movimentação dos produtos dentro da operação e propondo ações para reduzir perdas e aumentar a segurança dos processos.

Procuramos um profissional com experiência prática em prevenção de perdas dentro de operações logísticas/e-commerce, que tenha perfil analítico, investigativo e muita capacidade de atuação junto à operação.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar na prevenção e investigação de roubos, furtos, extravios, avarias e desvios de mercadorias;
  • Mapear os principais pontos de risco e vulnerabilidades da operação;
  • Acompanhar a movimentação dos produtos desde o recebimento até a expedição;
  • Analisar divergências de estoque, inventários e movimentações sistêmicas;
  • Realizar análises de ocorrências e identificar causas e responsáveis;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de perdas e elaborar relatórios gerenciais;
  • Identificar padrões de comportamento e situações suspeitas;
  • Atuar na análise de imagens de CFTV e demais evidências relacionadas às ocorrências;
  • Estruturar e acompanhar planos de ação para redução de perdas;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Operações, Segurança, RH e demais áreas envolvidas nas tratativas;
  • Apoiar a criação e revisão de procedimentos e controles internos;
  • Realizar auditorias e inspeções nos processos operacionais;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos procedimentos de segurança e prevenção de perdas;
  • Apoiar treinamentos e ações de conscientização das equipes;
  • Conduzir investigações internas relacionadas a perdas e desvios, seguindo os procedimentos da empresa.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência em Prevenção de Perdas em operações de e-commerce, logística, centros de distribuição ou fulfillment;
  • Experiência comprovada com investigação de roubos, furtos, extravios e divergências de mercadorias;
  • Vivência em operações de alto volume;
  • Conhecimento de processos de recebimento, armazenagem, picking, packing, expedição e/ou last mile;
  • Conhecimento em inventário e controle de estoque;
  • Capacidade analítica para identificação de causas e padrões de perdas;
  • Excel intermediário/avançado;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial nos galpões.

Perfil comportamental

Buscamos uma pessoa analítica, investigativa, observadora, organizada e bastante próxima da operação, com capacidade de questionar processos, identificar riscos e propor soluções.

É importante ter autonomia, senso de urgência, firmeza e boa comunicação, já que a posição terá contato frequente com diferentes áreas e níveis da operação.

title: Commercial Financial BP
description:
At Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies, our 8,000+ global associates are proud to come to work each day, knowing that what we do impacts the lives of patients around the world.

We make medical devices and related products that are used to collect, separate, manufacture and process various components of blood and cells. With our innovative technologies and service offerings, we touch a patient's life every second of every day and are committed to continuing to increase the number of patients we serve.

With some of the best and brightest minds in the industry, an unmatched global footprint, comprehensive benefits and a distinct culture, Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies is a great place to work, grow and be part of a team that is focused on making a difference. Consider joining our team and unlock your potential.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a Commercial Finance Business Partner LATAM to support the commercial organization across the region and act as a key financial partner in business growth and decision-making.

This is a regional role with exposure to multiple LATAM markets, working closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Operations and other business stakeholders. The position will play a critical role in connecting financial strategy with commercial objectives, providing insights that support profitable and sustainable growth.

The ideal candidate will combine strong financial expertise with a genuine business mindset, the ability to challenge commercial decisions constructively, and the agility to operate in a dynamic, multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with LATAM commercial leadership to analyze business performance and identify opportunities to improve sales, profitability and operating results.
  • Prepare and evaluate business cases for customer transactions, new business opportunities and strategic initiatives, providing financial recommendations to support decision-making.
  • Analyze sales, margins, profitability, pricing and operating expenses, identifying risks and opportunities and recommending proactive actions.
  • Lead and coordinate budgeting, forecasting and strategic planning processes across LATAM, including variance analysis and management reporting.
  • Develop financial models and projections for new business opportunities, customer solutions, investments and strategic projects.
  • Support the commercial organization in evaluating customer deals, pricing strategies and profitability, challenging assumptions when necessary to ensure sustainable growth.
  • Prepare weekly sales forecasts and monthly reports and dashboards to provide clear visibility into LATAM commercial performance.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations and Finance teams across different LATAM countries, acting as a bridge between regional and global finance organizations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, pricing competitiveness and financial efficiency across the region.
  • Support Sales and commercial teams with financial tools, analysis and training to strengthen business decision-making.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Education

• University degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration or a related field. Accounting background is a plus.

Experience

  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience, ideally with 5–8 years in Commercial Finance, FP&A or Business Partnering roles.
  • Experience working with commercial teams in a regional or multinational environment.
  • Strong understanding of pricing, profitability, forecasting and financial modeling.
  • Experience working across LATAM or other emerging markets is highly valued.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced financial modeling and analytical capabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and P&L analysis.
  • Experience with pricing and profitability analysis.
  • Ability to translate financial and market data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI.
  • Experience with ERP and financial systems, preferably SAP.

Business & Leadership Skills

  • Strong commercial mindset and understanding of business growth drivers.
  • Ability to influence decisions and challenge commercial strategies through data and financial insights.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders across different countries and cultures.

Languages

  • Advanced English is required.
  • Spanish and/or Portuguese are highly valued for regional collaboration.

Location & Travel

The position will be based in one of Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies' LATAM locations, with a regional scope covering key markets across Latin America. Availability to travel within the region as required.

WHY JOIN TERUMO BLOOD AND CELL TECHNOLOGIES?

Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies is part of Terumo Group, founded in 1921 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

In 2024, Terumo Blood and Cell Technologies reached $1.5 billion in revenue.

We employ nearly 8,000 associates globally, with global headquarters in Lakewood, CO, U.S., and regional headquarters in Brussels, Buenos Aires, Singapore and Tokyo.

We manufacture devices, disposable sets and solutions at our facilities in Belgium, India, Japan, Northern Ireland, the U.S. and Vietnam. Our global presence enables us to serve customers in more than 130 countries.

Our core values help set our direction, guide our actions and keep us true to our corporate mission of contributing to society through healthcare.

  • Respect – Appreciative of others
  • Integrity – Guided by our mission
  • Care – Empathetic to patients
  • Quality – Committed to excellence
  • Creativity – Striving for innovation

  • Conduzir reuniões de acompanhamento, alinhamentos técnicos e apresentações de status para a diretoria e sócios.

  • CREA ativo.

Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

title: Talent Attraction and Acquisition Professional
description:
Building connections. Creating possibilities.

Every terminal moves cargo. At Pecém, we move opportunities.

As one of Brazil's most important gateways for international trade and industrial growth, APM Terminals Pecém plays a critical role in connecting businesses, markets, and communities around the world.

At APM Terminals Pecém, employees become part of one of Brazil's most dynamic and strategically positioned gateways for global trade. With sustained growth, expanding capabilities, and continued investment, Pecém offers a high-impact environment where scale, complexity, and opportunity come together. Behind this success is a team driven by collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to continuous improvement.

Why you'll love it here

  • Contribute to an operation that helps drive economic growth and international connectivity.
  • Work in an environment where innovation and improvement are encouraged.
  • Access opportunities to learn new skills and broaden your experience.
  • Continuous improvement mindset – where curiosity is encouraged, root-cause problem solving is valued, and making things better every day is part of how we win.

At APM Terminals, a global leader in port and terminal operations, we enable global trade and drive sustainable growth. As part of the A.P. Moller-Maersk Group, we connect economies and communities worldwide. Our success is driven by a strong commitment to LEAN methodologies, embedding continuous improvement into every aspect of our operations. Join us and be part of a team that values excellence, collaboration, and innovation. Join us as we continue to shape the future of global trade and make a meaningful impact on communities worldwide. Discover your potential with APM Terminals and become part of a team that's redefining industry standards. Apply now and let's build a brighter future together.

The Opportunity

APM Terminals is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join the team in Pecém, Brazil. This role plays a critical part in attracting, engaging, and hiring top talent while delivering an exceptional candidate experience. Acting as a strategic partner to hiring managers and stakeholders, the Talent Acquisition Specialist will help build diverse, high-performing teams that support business growth and operational excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about connecting great talent with meaningful career opportunities, enjoys building strong relationships, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

What you'll be doing

Talent Sourcing

  • Develop and execute strategic sourcing plans.
  • Advertise open positions and proactively source qualified candidates.
  • Identify and assess internal talent for career opportunities.

Candidate Assessment

  • Review resumes and conduct initial candidate screenings.
  • Coordinate and facilitate phone interviews and selection processes.
  • Manage assessment activities and support hiring decisions.
  • Initiate and review background screening processes.

Offer Management

  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure alignment on compensation, benefits, and offer governance.
  • Support successful offer negotiations and candidate acceptance.

Market Intelligence

  • Analyze talent markets and identify the most effective sourcing channels.
  • Stay informed on recruitment trends, talent insights, and industry best practices.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Collaborate closely with hiring managers throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
  • Gather and manage interview feedback to support informed hiring decisions.
  • Partner with onboarding teams to ensure a seamless transition for new hires.

Compliance & Data Integrity

  • Maintain accurate candidate records and hiring statuses in Workday.
  • Ensure recruitment activities comply with company policies and local labor regulations.

What we can offer

At APM Terminals, we foster a dynamic learning and training culture that empowers employees to excel. Our commitment to continuous improvement is driven by LEAN principles, ensuring every team member has opportunities to develop new capabilities and advance their careers. Join an innovative environment where growth is a priority and where employees benefit from:

  • Continuous learning and development opportunities.
  • Exposure to a global business and international career paths.
  • A collaborative and inclusive culture.
  • Opportunities to contribute to transformation and innovation initiatives.
  • A workplace that values safety, well-being, and professional growth.

What we are looking for

The ideal candidate is passionate about matching talent to business needs and delivering an exceptional candidate experience from application to onboarding. They are comfortable managing multiple priorities, working independently, and building strong relationships with candidates and stakeholders.

Required qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Fluent Portuguese and advanced English.
  • Spanish is considered an advantage.
  • Experience with process improvement, standardization, and project implementation is a plus.
  • Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to assess talent and make data-driven hiring decisions.
  • Excellent collaboration, communication, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of employer branding and candidate attraction strategies.
  • Experience supporting Diversity & Inclusion initiatives within Talent Acquisition.
  • Structured work approach with a focus on delivering results.

Lean-minded: we are looking for someone who brings a strong mindset of continuous improvement – someone who is naturally curious, committed to solving problems at the root, and driven to make things better every day.

About APM Terminals

A.P. Moller-Maersk is an integrated container logistics company that connects and simplifies supply chains across the globe. Operating in more than 130 countries and employing approximately 70,000 people worldwide, we help our customers trade and grow by delivering end-to-end logistics solutions and digital services.

title: Analista de Facilities
description:

  • Atuar na gestão de indicadores, custos, conformidade legal e projetos de melhoria, além de oferecer suporte às unidades, promovendo qualidade, sustentabilidade e excelência na operação de Facilities, garantindo que os recursos e processos estejam alinhados às necessidades da organização e ao valor percebido pelos clientes interno e externos;

  • Acompanhar obras, reformas e projetos de melhorias, verificando o cumprimento de cronogramas, padrões de qualidade, segurança e conformidade legal, registrando ocorrências e apoiando fornecedores e áreas internas para assegurar a execução adequada e o valor agregado às instalações;

  • Controlar o funcionamento contínuo e eficiente das utilidades e sistemas prediais (energia, água, climatização, entre outros), monitorando consumos, verificando condições operacionais, acompanhando fornecedores e registrando ocorrências;

  • Atender às demandas de Facilities das unidades, acompanhando solicitações, orientando processos e articulando com fornecedores e áreas internas, de modo a garantir suporte técnico, agilidade e qualidade na solução das necessidades operacionais.

Requisitos

  • Conhecimento em manutenção predial, civil, elétrica, hidráulica e climatização;
  • Diferencial: ter atuado com MS Project ou AutoCAD;
  • Necessário ter disponibilidade para viagens (em torno de 1 vez por mês).

Estamos ansiosos para conhecê-lo(a) e juntos evoluirmos na construção de um ambiente de trabalho ainda mais inspirador.

Somos movidos por energia!
